Hi Stephanie / Marcus —

Thanks again for the conversation last month. Per our roadmap call I wanted to kick off the formal renewal playbook so we keep timing tight and scope the Dedicated capacity uplift you requested. High-level plan below and a short ask to pick QBR slots so we can lock exec availability.

Proposed 3-week timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Agree mutual action plan (MAP), confirm decision-makers, and lock QBR date
- Week 1: Finalize term amendments & pricing for Dedicated 2x pool; legal starts SOW redlines
- Week 2: Procurement sign-off & deployment readiness (staging capacity test)

Key asks
1) Please confirm who will be the procurement contact for contract redlines (I see procurement@streamlinehealth.com, correct?)
2) Pick two preferred QBR time windows (teams below — we can host remote):
   - Tue 23 Jul 10:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–15:00 PT
   - Thu 25 Jul 09:00–10:00 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft MAP and the preliminary SOW (SOW_Draft_Streamline_2029-07.pdf). The MAP highlights milestones, owners, and the proposed term change (12 -> 24 months with a stepped pricing uplift to reserve Dedicated pools).

Internal folks on this thread: Marissa (CS lead) will run the QBR and runbook; Irene will own governance/SLA checks; Ben — can you confirm margin/rate for Dedicated 2x proposal? Monica — can you prepare a short pre-QBR capacity plan (staging checklist + perf targets)?

I’ll follow up with a calendar poll once we have two preferred windows.

Thanks —
David

Proposed structure: 0–6 months: +18% unit rate; 7–18 months: +10%; 19–24 months: +5% (this preserves some upside for Redwood while giving Streamline room to scale down). I’ve attached a redlined pricing sheet to the MAP (see Streamline_MutualActionPlan_v3.xlsx tab "Pricing-Proposal").
